edgeCatalog.description: Functional, architectural or data dependency where target is required for source execution.
edgeCatalog.invalidationBehavior: If target degrades (health < 50% or FAILED), source is automatically marked BLOCKED.

edgeCatalog.description: Hierarchical organizational, tenant, or structural ownership containment.
edgeCatalog.invalidationBehavior: Deprecation or decommissioning of source cascades downward to all owned entities.

edgeCatalog.description: Direct causal link between an event, incident, or mutation and its resulting system state.
edgeCatalog.invalidationBehavior: Traces root cause during forensic investigation and illuminates failure paths.

edgeCatalog.description: Traceability link demonstrating a service or component fulfills a declared requirement.
edgeCatalog.invalidationBehavior: Modifications to target code trigger automated contract re-verification.

edgeCatalog.description: Hosting, runtime platform or physical/cloud infrastructure binding.
edgeCatalog.invalidationBehavior: Target gateway disconnect or latency spike cascades to source service latency.

edgeCatalog.description: Cryptographic or empirical validation link where a test receipt or proof validates an invariant.
edgeCatalog.directionalSemantics: Source (Test Harness / Receipt) -> Target (Release / Invariant Claim)
edgeCatalog.invalidationBehavior: Test regression or evidence expiration (>24h) immediately sets target state to STALE.

edgeCatalog.description: Policy, compliance, or security constraint enforcement.
edgeCatalog.directionalSemantics: Source (Governance Rule / Policy) -> Target (Governed Domain / Data)
edgeCatalog.invalidationBehavior: Policy violation halts downstream CI/CD deployment gates.

edgeCatalog.description: Transitive blast radius or side-effect propagation path.
edgeCatalog.invalidationBehavior: Used in counterfactual simulations to project blast radius score prior to merge.
